tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun khyer dam tshig nges pa'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru tā rā yai/ sangs rgyas phrin las kun 'byung zhing*// 'dod ldan rnams la byang chub ster// mkha' 'gro ma yi rigs 'dus pa// dam tshig sgrol ma la btud nas// rnal 'byor dang po'i dam tshig gis// phyag rgya nye bar sgrub pa'i thabs// lha dang sngags su byin brlabs pa// bsdus te bya ba'i rim pa bshad// de yang sngags brjod bdun las las dang po pa ye shes mi gsal ba'i gang zag spros pa la dga' zhing spros bcas mi 'khyong ba dag gis yongs su brtags pa'i rnal 'byor rgyun khyer bya ba la gsum ste thog mar tshogs bsag pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje sgrol mar gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i tām̐ yig gi 'od kyis lus kyi nang gang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag oṃ pad+ma tsan+d+ra arka bi ma le swā hā/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan brtsegs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis sgrol ma 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hūm̐ phaṭa sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ sogs nas/ shab+daṃ pra tīts+tsha na ma/ oṃ las byung ba'i me tog phul par gyur/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te puṣ+pe ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṣ+pe puṣ+pe ma hā puṣ+pe su puṣ+pe puṣ+pa uta bha be puṣ+pa ki ra ṇe swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// lan gsum/ rjes btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs te thim/ sems can thams cad sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ snying ga'i 'od kyis snang ba thams cad 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim/

bdag nyid kyang thugs ka'i tām̐ la thim/ snang ba tsam gyi rnam shes ni// sems tsam du ni rnam par brtag /nam mkhar rdo rjer gnas sems 'di// chos can med cing chos nyid med// sa bon de nyid kyang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang sems sgrol ma skyabs sbyin dang ut+pal 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas nam mkhar gnas/ rang sems kyi snang ba las byung ba'i 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus su rin po che'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i lte bar pad zla'i gdan la/ oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba la ā lis mtshan pa dang*/ āḥlas byung ba'i nyi ma kā lis mtshan pa la nam mkha'i lha mo thim/ zla ba'i dbus su tām̐ ljang sngon/ de las ut+pal sngon por gyur/ de thams cad las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sgrol ma'i rnam par spyan drangs tām̐ la thim/ thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo dam tshig sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma/ sku mdog sngo zhing yid tsam ljang ba/ pad+ma rā ga lta bu'i 'od zer dmar ba 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa na gri gug gsum pa na cang te'u/ bzhi pa na mda'/ g.yon gyi dang pos rab tu rgyas pa'i ut+pal sngon po'i sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa na ka pā la khrag gis gang ba/ gsum pa na mdung rtse gsum/ bzhi pa na me tog gi gzhu 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon tu rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsgrengs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgyas sku la brgyan cing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ mgo rlon gyi phreng ba dang ut+pal dmar po'i do shal 'phyang ba/ drag mo chen mo/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/

mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la bab cing*/ dbu skra nag po phyed bcings shing phyed grol ba/ zhabs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ phyi rol du me dpung 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'o// dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la mig tu oṃ tā re swā hā dkar po/ rna bar oṃ tut+tā re swā hā sngon po/ lce la oṃ tu swā hā dmar po/ snying gar oṃ re swā hā sngon po/ spyi bor oṃ tā re ṇi swā hā ljang gu/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ dkar po/ rna bar dz+riṃ nag po/ snar kham̐ ser po/ lcer gam̐ dmar po/ dpral bar skam̐ ljang gu/ lte bar sam̐ sngon po/ snying ga'i dbus su dpal don yod grub pa rdo rje rta'i rgyal po rab tu khros pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba ut+pal tām̐ yig ljang sngon gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ slar yang snying ga'i 'od kyis dbang lha dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas yum lngas bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang bskur bar gyur/ om̐ lam̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

bum dbang*/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+rim̐ kham̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ cod pan/ oṃ hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐ rdo rje badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ ming dbang*/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs/ s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ dril bu/ gsang dbang*/ gtso mo dang don grub yab yum snyom par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems khar byin par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdag nyid yab dang lha mo rnams dam tshig sgrol mar sher dbang*/ bdag po'i dbang*/ gyur pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos gtad pa la snyoms pa bzhugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dbang lha rnams rigs bdag don yod grub pa'i rnam par gyur nas dbu brgyan/ bzhi pa'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ mtshan nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'am/ mtshan nges par grags pas bstod de/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ las kyi rigs thams cad kyi bdag po/ rgyu ba dang*/ mi rgyu ba'i byed pa po/ brtan pa dang*/ g.yo ba'i rang bzhin/ gsang ba las ches shin tu gsang ba/ gsang ba chen po'i dbang phyug mas bdag nyid kyi rdo rje'i ming 'di rnams nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*// bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma/ rdo rje ma/ dam tshig sgrol ma/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ ye shes lngas brgyan pa ma/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur ma/

ye shes dkyil 'khor/ zla ba'i bde ma/ ngo mtshar bde ma/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 'dod ma/ phung po'i bdag mo/ skye mched kyi bdag mor gyur pa/ 'byung ba rnams rab tu thob pa/ yul dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ rgyud kun gyi dbang phyug ma/ ye shes rnam pa lngas byang chub pa/ rdul dang bral ba/ dri ma med pa/ gsang sngags chen po/ shin tu phra ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyis spras pa/ dag byed dag byed chen mo/ las thams cad grub par byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ yi ge bcu'i sgra sgrogs ma/ sgra sgrogs dgyes ma/ gdung ma/ myur ba ma/ rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa/ sra zhing bde ba ye shes snying po/ bde ba chen mo'o// de skad kyang bka' stsal to// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu tī ra badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ gi mthar/ yi ge bcu pas g.yas bskor du bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te snying ga'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes rtsa ba'i yig bcu ci nus bzla/ oṃ tā re tu re tut+tā re hūm̐ phaṭa/ sku'i bzlas pa'o// oṃ tā re swā hā/ gsung gi bzlas pa'o// oṃ āḥtām̐ hūm̐/ thugs kyi bzlas pa'o// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ā r+ya a wa lo ki ti shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā satwa ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ/ pra duṣ+ṭaṃ/ ma ma kri te/ dzaṃ bha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+dha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ staṃ bha ni tā re swā hā/ las kyi sngags te cung zad re bzla'o// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba las rjes su bzung ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas sgrol ma phyag gnyis ma/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang ut+pal thogs pa brgyad spros te/

sems can rnams kyi 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug bskyabs par bsams la/ oṃ oṃswā hā/ oṃ tā swā hā/ o re swā hā/ oṃ tu ta swā hā/ oṃ tā swā hā/ oṃ re swā hā/ oṃ tu swā hā/ oṃ re swā hā/ zhes bzla/ tshar gcad pa ni/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thugs rje chen pos khros te thugs ka nas pho nya phyag brnyan mo bcu gnyis spros shing*/ de las kyang sprul pa'i khro bo khro mo mtha' yas pa spros te bdud bzhi la sogs pa byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i ma rungs gdug pa can thams cad la phur bus btab cing tshar bcad par gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bzla/ 'di gnyis rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la ma byas kyang chog de nas/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ sogs kyis bstod/ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor rang gi lus la thim/ rang nyid kyang thugs ka'i tām̐ la thim/ de yang cha lnga'i rim pas nā da la bsdus/ de yang stong pa nyid du thim par gyur/ āḥ zhes rang bzhin med pa'i gzungs kyi sgo la ci rigs gnas shing ldang ba na/ slar bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur gyur/ dge ba bsngo/ gtor 'bul dang*/ rnal 'byor phyi ma gsum gyi snying po bsgom par 'dod na gzhan du shes par bya/ yang na rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la rtsa ba'i lha dpa' mo gcig pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgom bzlas byas kyang legs shing 'brel chags pa'o// dran pas 'jigs pa ma lus 'joms// bsgoms pas snying la bde chen ster// sgrol ma'i rnal 'byor 'di byas pas// bdag dang 'gro kun rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa'ang kun mkhyen mañdzu shrī dang*/ rang slob ī shwa ra sogs kyi snga phyir bskul ma mdzad pa ltar/ yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs ri khrod du 'grub sbyor dang ldan pa'i tshes bzang po'i snga dro'i thun mtshams su lha dang bla mas gnang ba'i mtshan ma dge ba dang bcas sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//

༈ /sgrol ma rang gis dam bcas pa'i gzungs ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ tā re tā rā yai hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ sa ma ya s+thi te/ bha ra bha ra sarba bha ra ṇa bi bhū ṣi te/ pad+me ni pad+me ma hā pad+me a sa na s+thi te/ ha sa ha sa trai lo kya pa ra be sha sar+b+bā de ba dā na ba/ pū dzi te sma ra hi/ bha ga ba ti tā re sma ra hi bha ga ban+ta ta thā ga ta s+ya/ su ra te sa ma yaṃ dha ra dhā ra mahā satwa bi lo ki te/ ma ṇi ka na ka bi tsi tra bha ra ṇe oṃ bi lo kā ya/ bha ga ba ti tā re/ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ phaṭa swā hā/ 'di phan yon dpag tu med cing 'be lo tsā bas rgya dpe la gtugs pas dag par yod do// ༈ /dam tshig sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rig pa gtad pa'i cho ga ye shes sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// sangs rgyas phrin las dam tshig gis// 'gro kun sgrol mdzad der btud nas// las dang po la gces pa yi// rig pa gtad pa'i cho ga dgod// ma rgyud rta'i rgyal po'i rigs dam tshig sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'i las dang po pa la sngags kyi rig pa gtad pa'i cho gas snod rung du bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi mdun nam gang bder stegs bu khebs ldan gyi steng du bum pa bcud ldan kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa me tog gi phreng ba dngos sam ri mor bris pa rnams dgod/ phyi mchod phreng tshar du gsham/ rus pa'i phreng ba dang 'thor nas sogs nyer mkho rnams kyang tshogs par bya/ bgegs sbyong ba'i gtor ma snod gcig tu 'bras zan dang shing tog bsres pa lnga tshom la dpal 'bar lnga btsugs pa'ang bzhag go /de nas slob dpon gyis skyabs sems nas brtsams/ lha bskyed/ bzlas pa ci 'grub/ bsdu ldang gi bar bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig byas la/ bum pa'i chu la dmigs te/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes rtsa sngags ci nus bzla/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ tā re swā hā/ oṃ āḥtrām̐ hūm̐/ zhes sku gsung thugs sngags dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ/ pra duṣ+ṭaṃ/ ma ma kṛ te/ dzaṃ bha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+dha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ/ s+t+waṃ bha ni tā re swā hā/ zhes las sngags dang*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tā re shān+tīṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ tā re puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re wa sha ma na ya hoḥ oṃ tā re ni wa ra ya phaṭa/ oṃ ta thā ga ta tā re lam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na tā re mām̐ hūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma tā re bām̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra tā re hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ aṅku sha tā re dzaḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā sha tā re hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ shrī kha la tā re baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ ghaṇ+ḍe tā re hoḥhūm̐/ oṃ mo ha ni tā ri mam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ pra sha ma ni tā re swā hā hūm̐/ oṃ s+t+wa ma bha ni tā re lam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ dzam+bha ni tā re kham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ ā kar+ṣa ṇi tā re hrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ kī la ka tā re dzaḥhūm̐/ oṃ uts+tshā ṭa ka tā re phaṭa hūm̐/ oṃ dwe ṣa ka tā re phaṭa hūm̐/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ni bhu ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a mṛ tu kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mtshan sngags kyi phreng ba rnams kyang lan nyer gcig gam bdun sogs gang rung bzlas pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas slob ma rnams las sngags a mṛ ta bzlas pa'i chus khrus bya/ nang du me tog bcas 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ de la thog ma dang tha ma ma mchis pa'i bskal pa rnams su phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams kyi 'gro ba ma bsgral ba thams cad yang dag par sgrol zhing*/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa las bde blag tu skyob par mdzad pa'i thugs rje'i mthu stobs shin tu myur bas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la mnga' dbang mdzad pa rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la sgrub thabs kyi rim pa mtha' yas pa zhig bzhugs pa las/

ches zab cing dkon la khyad par du 'phags pa rnal 'byor ma rgyud rta'i rgyal po'i rigs sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po la brten pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa ring brgyud bhaṃ ga la'i grub thob ha ya pā la sogs las byung zhing 'phags pa klu sgrub dang nyi ma sbas pa sogs kyis rgya cher spel ba dang*/ nye brgyud grub chen te lo pa la sgrol ma nyid kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs shing rgyud gtad pa nas rim par rtsod dus kyi grub pa'i dbang phyug zhi ba sbas pa la bka' babs shing*/ de nyid kyi slob ma'i thu bo sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po la rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā thas gsan te rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i bar byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun zam ma chad par byon pa 'di la smin grol gyi gdams pa'i bka' srol zab mo rgya cher bzhugs pa las/ 'dir dbang po dman pa rnams rjes su 'dzin pa sngags kyi rig pa gtad pa'i cho ga bsgrub pa la bdag nyid kyis bya bar 'os pa rnams grub pa yin pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa rig gtad zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug gus pa chen pos thal mo sbyar la don gnyer gyi bsam pa khyad par can dang ldan pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag la bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rig sngags dam pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ bgegs gtor dpal 'bar spar ba thogs la/ khyed rang gi lte ba snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sangs rgyas spyan ma/ mā ma kī/ gos dkar mo/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ sgrol ma ste yum lnga gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer byung*/ khams lnga la brten pa'i nad gdon rnam par rtog pa thams cad khyi dang spre'u'i tshul gyis phyir byung ste sgron me lnga la thim par sgoms shig

byas la sngags tshan go rim bzhin slob ma'i lte ba sogs gnas lngar bskor zhing dril bu gsil ba/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ya swā hā/ zhes lte ba/ oṃ badz+ra mā ma kī gi ri gi ri hūm̐ swā hā/ snying ga oṃ ka ṭe bi ka ṭe bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe swā hā/ mgrin pa/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ ha na ha na da ha da pa tsa pa tsa bi dh+wan sa ya bi dh+wa na sa ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ spyi bo/ oṃ badz+ra tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ gsang gnas su bskor la phyir dor/ gu gul bdug yungs kar gtor la/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+rī ṇāṃ/ na mo ma hā badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃṣ+ṭota ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la pa ra shu pā sha hastā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭa tiṣ+ṭa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nān/ bi nā ya ka ma hā ga ṇa pa ti dzi wi tān+ta ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bgegs bskrad/ de ltar bar du gcod pa'i bgegs bskrad pa de dag slar mi 'jug pa'i ched du rdo rje'i go bskon pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes pas spyi mgrin snying*/ dpung pa gnyis/ dpyi gnyis te gnas bdun du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bzhag go /rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du bla ma bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol ma dngos su gsal ba la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar du snying thag pa nas skyabs su mchi zhing*/ sgo gsum gyi sdig pa'i las rnams gnod 'gyod drag pos bshags pa dang*/ 'phags skye'i dge ba mtha' dag la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ 'gro ba'i don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i slad du byang chub kyi sems bzung zhing de'i bslab pa la slob par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang dam tshig sgrol ma rtsa ba'i lha 'di ltar du gsal thob cig oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ chos thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ khyed rang gang du gnas pa'i go sar sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems nyid tām̐ yig ljang sngon las ut+pal sngon po tām̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sgrol ma'i rnam par spyan drangs sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol ma sku mdog sngo zhing yid tsam ljang la 'od zer 'phros/ lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la babs pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ phyag g.yas pas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pas rab tu rgyas pa'i ut+pa la'i sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dbu skra nag po phyed bcings shing phyed grol ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ zhabs g.yon bskum zhing g.yas brkyang bskyil krung phyed pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la mig tu oṃ tā re swā hā dkar po/ rna bar oṃ tut+tā re swā hā sngon po/ lce la oṃ tu swā hā dmar po/ snying gar oṃ re swā hā sngon po/ spyi bor oṃ tā re ṇi swā hā ljang gu/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ dkar po sa'i snying po'i ngo bo/ rna bar dz+riṃ nag po phyag na rdo rje'i ngo bo/ snar kham̐ ser po nam mkha'i snying po'i ngo bo/ lcer gam̐ dmar po 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ngo bo/ dpral bar skam̐ ljang gu sgrib pa rnam sel gyi ngo bo/ lte bar sam̐ sngon po kun tu bzang po'i ngo bor gsal bar gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

sangs rgyas thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol ma'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ yang thugs ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chus gang bas dbang bskur bar gyur/ bum pa thogs la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes spyi bor bzhag bum chu 'thor blud bya/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha rnams kyis dbang rtags su rin po che'i cod pan spyi bor bcings pas rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab par mos shig me tog phreng ba mgor bzhag la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du mos pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ slob dpon dam tshig sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros/ khyed rang sgrol mar gsal ba'i zhal du bzhugs/ snying gar zla steng tām̐ yig gi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pas 'di yi rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ mi rus kyi phreng ba mgrin par bzhag la yi ge bcu pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug rjes byin gyis brlab pa'i slad du slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin tu 'di'i rjes zlos/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/

slob dpon gyis me tog spyi bor bzhag bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyi// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje'i slob ma 'di nyid kyi rgyud la/ bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus mthu ma lus pa thogs med du 'jug par gyur cig ces dang rten snying brjod/ deng phyin chad bla ma nam du'ang spang bar ma byed cig ces pa sgo/ de dag gis las dang po pa dang dbang po dman pa rnams rjes su 'dzin par byed pa rig pa gtad pa'i dbang gi cho ga grub pa yin pas ji skad bshad pa'i dam tshig las 'da' bar mi bgyid do snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ dge bsngo rnams spyi ltar bya/ slob dpon gyis sgrub thabs rgyas pa bsgoms na gtor chog phyin chad dkyus bzhin dang*/ bsdus pa'i skabs/ yig brgya lan gsum bzlas la/ dge bsngo shis brjod tsam bya'o// rtsa ba'i dbang las rig gtad khol phyung du bskur ba'i tshul 'di rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pas dkyil chog gzhan la phan par dngos su gsungs shing*/ der rigs lnga'i sdom bzung*/ sems bskyed dang dam bzhag bzhi/ ye shes dbab pa/ nang dbang bcas dor ba'i 'jug chog rdzogs par gsungs pa ni mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i phyogs yin la/ bsdu na 'di tsam gyis dgongs don 'grub bo// chos 'di thab 'og gter bzhin tu// gyur la 'di tsam nyid kyis kyang*// kha byang bzhin gyur mtha' yas pa'i// skal ldan kun spyod rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'ang bcom ldan 'das mas dngos su rjes su bzung ba'i 'jigs bral gyi slob dpon chen po khyab bdag 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i bka' lung u dum+ba ra'i phreng ba thod du bcings te/

ku sā li yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes 'phags ma dgyes pa'i bsti gnas su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
